name: Smoke
overview: Scripture uses smoke both literally and figuratively to reveal God's presence and judgment. In Psalms 18:8 and Revelation 15:8, smoke symbolizes the overwhelming glory and power of God filling His temple, marking His holiness and divine authority. Conversely, Hosea 13:3 depicts smoke as a fleeting, transient image, illustrating the impermanence of human life and pride. Isaiah 6:4 also shows smoke filling the temple, emphasizing the awe-inspiring and sanctifying atmosphere surrounding God's throne.
